title: [auto-fix] Restore correct hexadecimal digit conversion
description:
The regression changes the letter-digit offset from 9 to 8, so A–F decode one lower than their hexadecimal values. Restoring the offset fixes the reported escape and unescape failures.

Reproduced failing tests:
- `CEscape.EscapeAndUnescape`
- `Unescape.BasicFunction`
- `CUnescapeTest.UnescapesMultipleHexNulls`
